# ShaderX

> Kotlin Multiplatform GPU shader effects for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

Published dependency: io.github.debanshu777:shaderx:0.1.3.
The main branch develops 0.1.4. Session animation, texture uniforms, and audio effects require that development source; do not assume they exist in 0.1.3.
Packages use com.debanshu.shaderlab.shaderx. Android requires API 33+. Skia rejects multi-effect composites. Android offline image processing currently returns a processing failure.

## Source

- [GitHub and Markdown documentation](https://github.com/Debanshu777/ShaderX)
- [Published releases](https://github.com/Debanshu777/ShaderX/releases)
- [Public source](https://github.com/Debanshu777/ShaderX/tree/main/shaderx/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/debanshu/shaderlab/shaderx)

The documentation is built from the repository's docs directory. Until GitHub Pages is enabled, use those Markdown guides on GitHub. Custom app effects implement RuntimeShaderEffect; the abstract effect base classes depend on internal handlers.
